# Ocean Fishing Achievements
## What Did Octopodes Do to You? - Assumes Lv90, and high GP. Not good for points, just achievement.
### Zone 1 Normal. - Do not trigger Spec. Stop when Angler's Art is at 10 stacks.
```
AH4_
```
### Zone 2 Normal. - Any weather except Clouds or Fog
```
AH4_
```
### Zone 2 Normal. - Clouds or Fog
```
AH4_
```
### Zone 2 Spectral.
```
AH4_
```
### Zone 3 Normal.
```
AH4_
```
### Zone 3 Spectral. - If under patience, stop fishing and recast to drop debuff.
```
AH4_
```
## What Did Sharks Do to You? - Assumes Lv90, and high GP. Not good for points, just achievement.
### Zone 1 Normal. - Save GP when possible; IC if capped.
```
AH4_
```
### Zone 1 Spectral. Hook !! and !!!. IC–DH if you catch a Ghost Shark; !!! is a blind DH–IC–DH.
```
AH4_
```
### Zone 2 Normal. - No Sharks here, Collect Anglers Art to 10, try for yolo Coral Manta with Shrimp Cage Feeder.
```
AH4_
```
### Zone 3 Normal. - Can blind DH Chrome Hammerheads at <20s.
```
AH4_
```
### Zone 3 Spectral. - Hook !! and !!!. If you catch a Sweeper, can use IC if high on GP. !!! is a blind DH.
```
AH4_
```
